7.2 What Helps Creativity?
Have you ever made up a new game? Cooked something by mixing things in a new way?
That's creativity! It doesn't only belong to artists or scientists, it belongs to all of us.
Beavers build dams, birds build nests but they do it the same way every time. We, on the 
other hand, can invent new music, change the way we dress, even make machines that 
talk like humans! But what helps us become more creative? And what blocks us?
